parts:
On Fri, 2016-01-22 at 20:56 -0800, Eric Coker wrote:
> I am at a loss as to why none of my models are running. I get some
> strage error. Yet I've worked with INLA for quite a long time now
> withoug running accross such problems. I've included the output with
> verbose=T. I'm looking for any insights.

Hi,

that is weird. 

I wonder if the simplest model goes through,

inla(y ~ 1, data = data.frame(y=0))


otherwise, it can be something with the new builds and/or the
interaction with R. the easiest way to check this is to remove R &
libraries, and reinstall everything (and the newest testing-version).
if that fail, see if there is anything in some 'anti-virus' software
that 'protect' things from happen. another alternative, is to build a
special version without any optim-options and see if that goes
through. 

let me know.... (we might continue this discussion on he...@r-inla.org,
maybe, and return to the list with the way out of this).
